name: Oman
shortSummary: Oman is one of India's oldest Gulf partners, offering the Indian Navy access to the strategically located Port of Duqm — a key node for Indian Ocean and Indo-Pacific power projection.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: Duqm access underpins Indian naval operations toward the Gulf of Aden and Horn of Africa.
Joint ventures in fertiliser production supply Indian agriculture.

recentDevelopments.title: Continued naval access and logistics cooperation
recentDevelopments.description: Indian Navy access to the Port of Duqm continued under the 2018 agreement, supporting operations toward the Gulf of Aden.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: Remains one of India's few reliable foreign naval logistics footholds in the western Indian Ocean.

historicalEvents.title: Strategic Partnership
historicalEvents.description: India and Oman establish a Strategic Partnership covering defence and energy.

historicalEvents.title: Duqm Port and Military Access Agreement
historicalEvents.description: Oman grants India logistical access to the Port of Duqm, strengthening India's Indian Ocean naval reach.
historicalEvents.impact: Provided India a rare foreign military logistics foothold near the Arabian Sea and Gulf of Aden.

agreements.name: Duqm Port Access Agreement
agreements.description: Framework granting the Indian Navy logistical support and access at the Port of Duqm.

defenceCooperation.name: Al Najah
defenceCooperation.description: Bilateral army exercise between India and Oman.

defenceCooperation.name: Duqm access
defenceCooperation.description: Indian naval access and berthing rights at Duqm port.
